description: Balanced sampler ONLY: sampler is the sole change vs. no augmentation beyond the light flip/rotation/ColorJitter that already existed in the codebase (dataset_pipeline/face_transforms.py). No RandomResizedCrop, no blur, no JPEG, no resolution-loss simulation.
transform_repr:
Compose(
      Resize(size=[224, 224], interpolation=bilinear, antialias=True)
      RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
      RandomRotation(degrees=[-5.0, 5.0], interpolation=nearest, expand=False, fill=0)
      ColorJitter(brightness=(0.8, 1.2), contrast=(0.8, 1.2), saturation=(0.9, 1.1))
      ToImage()
      ToDtype(scale=True)
      Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225], inplace=False)
)
